column1: # IT6805 stable-entry sequence (video locked), single-pixel SDR: measure, output bus, colour, mute, video logic reset, unblank. Values for 1080p59.94 YCbCr 4:4:4 8-bit; MODE notes give RGB values
# evidence: T3/S31 38385-38681 ms and 27718 ms (YCbCr 4:4:4, Roku); T4/S41 92588 ms, T4/S44 2956 ms, T4/S45 8890 ms (1080p60 RGB, PC source); S

# op: W write value (mask ff) · M read-modify-write: new = (old & ~mask) | value · D delay, value = ms (RD nominal; RD's real sleeps were longer) · P poll until (reg & mask) == value · R read, value = traced (informative) · X step described in hdmi-it6805.md (§ in note)
# dev: 8-bit I2C address on bus 1 (90 IT6805, e0 IT6805 sub-block). bank: bank in effect (reg 0x0f[2:0]); * = the bank register itself; - = not banked. All numbers hex except D values (decimal ms).

# RD = reference driver. Values are what RD wrote. R rows are informative reads; RD also read most registers before writing them (omitted). RD's repeated selects of an already selected bank are omitted: the bank column gives the bank in effect.
# Rows whose note starts with MODE depend on the input; the chapter (§10) gives the rules. Dual-pixel variants: it6805-lock-dual-sdr.tsv, it6805-lock-dual-ddr.tsv.

# Replay check (D): with the MODE values of each input this reproduces every IT6805 register write of the five traced single-pixel entries in order, value and bank, except the bus-setting 0:6b row where RD writes the output colour of the previous lock (row note).
# Runs once, in the 4th poll after the poll that detected sync (§7.5). AV-mute release and audio enable follow in later polls (§7.7, §11).

MODE: input colour [5:4] from AVI Y (RGB 00, 4:2:2 10, 4:4:4 20, 4:2:0 30); DVI: 10
